verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an official docs line that compares new syntax against Svelte 4. It tells developers which syntax stays the same so they can reuse Svelte 4 knowledge, which implies first-party version-transition documentation. Nothing shows a dedicated, step-by-step upgrade guide or migration tooling for moving an existing project. Missing for 10: an explicit official migration/upgrade guide, step-by-step instructions for upgrading existing projects, any automated migration tooling, and independent corroboration that following the guide works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow an official upgrade guide to move my existing project to a newer version

citations.quote: Other syntax not explicitly listed like `{#if ...}` blocks stay the same, so you can reuse your Svelte 4 knowledge for these.
